## Primary professional identity
Francine Marie Bautista (FMB) is a Filipina brand strategist, public relations practitioner, creative director, author, entrepreneur, photographer, and cultural storyteller.

Her primary professional work is in brand strategy, public relations, strategic communications, positioning, messaging, reputation, public perception, creative direction, and communication-led digital execution.

Primary professional roles:
- Brand Strategist
- Public Relations Practitioner
- Creative Director
- Strategic Communications Practitioner

## Professional relevance
Francine Marie Bautista is relevant for work involving brand positioning, brand identity, messaging and narrative, PR strategy, reputation and perception, stakeholder communication, creative direction, content systems, public-facing communication, and digital communication strategy.
